## Website Purpose
This website provides legal services for continuous power of attorney (ייפוי כוח מתמשך) in Tel Aviv, Israel, with lawyer Inbal Hanasab.

## Key Content Areas
- Continuous Power of Attorney Services
- Legal process and steps
- Information about lawyer Inbal Hanasab
- FAQ and contact information
- Tel Aviv and central Israel service area

## Language
Hebrew (RTL)

## Services Offered
- Continuous Power of Attorney documentation
- Advance Directives
- Attorney selection guidance
- Deposit with Public Guardian

## Answer Engine Summary
Adv. Inbal Hanasab provides Hebrew-language legal guidance in Tel Aviv for people who want to prepare a continuous power of attorney. The site explains what the document covers, when it may be useful, how the process works, and how to contact Inbal for a short introductory conversation.

- Does it enter into effect immediately?
- Who can be appointed as attorney-in-fact?
- Can more than one person be appointed?
- Can advance instructions be included?
- Is the service focused on Tel Aviv and central Israel?
